incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1: Increased error rate + token latency spike for v2 inference (tool/function calls with structured JSON output). Triggered 1945678901. Paging alice_oncall.
alice_oncall: on it — grabbing logs now. can someone post quick summary of what changed in the last deploy window?
ben_runtime: seeing a huge rise in kvcache miss rate starting ~1945678860. continuous-batcher is splitting sequences often because funcall outputs include large JSON arrays; that causes many small partial batches and TTL churn. p95 token latency up from 80ms -> 600ms on impacted shards.
carla_ml: we shipped a prefetch + structured-output streaming optimization earlier in the week (rollout 1945590000) that aggressively prefetches KV entries for predicted toolcall tokens. suspect logic mis-predicts when structured JSON arrays show up, prefetch gets evicted quickly.
dan_sre: are there any active customer complaints? frank_support?
frank_support: flagged two customers (acme-ai, partner-x) with increased 5xx and long tails. They reported partial responses / timeouts hitting our hosted API starting ~22:40 UTC. I've opened tickets and sent status updates.
alice_oncall: OK. immediate mitigation ideas: 1) disable prefetch for funcall paths 2) reduce continuous_batching.max_batch_ms so batches flush less often 3) fallback structured-output to non-streaming path to avoid early flushes. Which is fastest to rollback?
ben_runtime: fastest is disabling prefetch via config flag: runtime.flags.kv_prefetch=false (hot reconfig on routing layer). second is patching batcher config: set max_batch_ms from 50 -> 12 for affected service tier. disabling structured streaming requires a code deploy to the serving runtime — longer.
carla_ml: confirm structured output messages are longer on average and include nested arrays which cause boundary tokens that our tokenizer splits across requests, so the batcher treats them as separate sequences.
ops-bot: Deploy job queued: patch-config/kvcache-prefetch-toggle -> ready for rollout to production edge (canary first).
alice_oncall: rolling the flag to canary now (10%): /deploy patch-config/kvcache-prefetch-toggle --canary 10
ben_runtime: canary shows immediate drop in kvcache miss rate on canary hosts. stacking metrics: miss_rate dropped from 78% -> 12% on canary, p95 token latency back to ~95ms.
dan_sre: good. let's expand canary to 50% and monitor error rate and client 5xx.
alice_oncall: expanding to 50% now.
frank_support: customers on canary noticed improvement in tail latency — acme-ai reports partial responses cleared.
ben_runtime: while expanding, I'm also preparing an emergency batch-config that caps batch_size to 8 and sets max_batch_ms 15ms to avoid large queueing fragmentation. patch below:

```
# emergency batch config
service: v2-inference
continuous_batching:
  max_batch_ms: 15
  max_batch_size: 8
```

alice_oncall: apply batch cap to the rest of clusters after 50% canary validates. doing staged rollout.
ops-bot: Patch applied to remaining 50%.
carla_ml: note: this reduces throughput efficiency — cost will go up, but we avoid customer impact. we should prepare a more targeted hotfix to structured-output detection rather than global disabling.
ben_runtime: agreed. next step: add a heuristic to detect funcall-structured output (JSON-array heavy) and route it through a non-prefetch path. minimal code change: 1) detect schema with first 32 tokens; 2) set request.prefetch=false for that request. pushing PR now.
alice_oncall: link PR?
ben_runtime: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pull/4123 (WIP) — planning to land small change behind a flag: runtime.flags.detect_structured_funcall=true
ops-bot: CI green for PR 4123.
ben_runtime: deploying PR behind flag to canary 10% to validate behavior.
alice_oncall: while that rolls, service metrics look healthy. kvcache throttling and eviction rates normalized.
frank_support: update: I've posted a status note to the two impacted customers and set ETA for full resolution to 30 minutes. asked them to retry where possible; they acknowledged the update.
eva_prod: can we add a customer-impact summary to the incident postmortem? include which endpoints, time windows, and mitigation timeline.
dan_sre: yes. I'll collate logs and produce a timeline. initial impact window ~1945678855 -> 1945679050 (mitigation start), residuals until 1945679120.
alice_oncall: PR landed to canary and flagged. can we flip detect flag global after 10m observation?
ben_runtime: flipping detect flag to 100% now: runtime.flags.detect_structured_funcall=true
ops-bot: flag toggled for all production clusters.
alice_oncall: metrics check: kvcache miss_rate stable, p95 token latency back to baseline. I'm going to keep batch cap in place for 1 hour to smooth traffic.
carla_ml: create follow-up JIRA to add unit tests around tokenizer boundary handling for funcall outputs and to evaluate longer-term caching strategy for nested-JSON structures.
frank_support: customers confirmed recovery. acme-ai asked for timeline and root cause — I'll include our immediate actions and planned follow-ups.
alice_oncall: on-call handoff incoming: I'll be handing to ben_runtime in 30 minutes. ben, any runbook notes you want me to leave?
ben_runtime: leave current flags and batch cap state, link to PR 4123, and note to watch kvcache miss_rate and p95 token latency for 2 hours. escalate to dan_sre if miss_rate > 15%.
alice_oncall: handing off incident to ben_runtime. moving to watch mode.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: error rates and tail latency returned to acceptable SLOs. Resolution summary: rolled back aggressive kvcache prefetch for funcall paths, applied temporary batch caps, enabled request-level structured-output detection to avoid prefetch on JSON-array-heavy responses, and staged code hotfix behind a flag. incident duration ~ 6 minutes (mitigation path) but customer-facing window ~ 10 minutes. Postmortem owner: carla_ml. Link: /incidents/1945678901/postmortem
alice_oncall: closing thread here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
